description: This file defines the StackedColumn class used in the reporting module of the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates a hierarchical structure of report columns with methods to set and retrieve their properties, add child columns, and serialize the object to an array.

classes.name: StackedColumn
classes.description: A class representing a stacked column in a report header, supporting nested child columns and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StackedColumn with an array of child columns.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the optional name of the stacked column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves the array of child columns.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets multiple child columns, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a single child column to the collection.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the stacked column and its children into an array.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child columns.
